description.narrative:
The project is focused on combating corruption, promoting the law on criminal asset confiscation as part of its efforts to cooperate with institutions in good governance and fostering democracy. Moreover, the action also focuses on furthering public administration reforms, advancing access to justice contributing to protecting and promoting human rights as well as fundamental freedoms.

The project will contribute to the capacity building of rights-holders and duty-bearers by implementing the foreseen activities such as monitoring, trainings, online-courses, info sessions, debates etc.
